answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 21035 Country: India Title: i need guidence regarding the meaning of sidra can v keep the name of a girl as sidra fathima as my brother has named her child sidra fathima or do v need to change it plz advice. Question: Assalamu alaikum wr wb i need guidence regarding the meaning of sidra can v keep the name of a girl as sidra fathima as my brother has named her child sidra fathima or do v need to change it plz advice, jazak-allah Answer ID: 21035 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 435/435/M=1431) The meaning of Sidra is: a tree of berry / jujube. You can name your daughter Sidra Fatimah. However it is better to make Fatimah the first name and name her as Fatimah Sidra. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
